prompt:
Prop reference image for a film, photorealistic still, vertical composition. One object alone, centred and seen whole, filling most of the frame, straight on and slightly from above, on a plain light grey seamless background, in soft even light at a neutral daylight white balance. No person, hand, figure or reflection of one. Prop: wedding-gift box. An empty square white cardboard gift box, about 25 by 25 by 12 cm, with its lid off. A loose white satin ribbon and bow hang from it, and the inside is lined with white tissue paper. Cassie later crushes it into a crumpled shape. Any writing or badge a real one carries (a form's printed heading, field labels and filled-in lines, a maker's badge) is drawn crisp, legible and spelt correctly, as on the real thing. Show it exactly as described, in its first state, with nothing else in the frame.

Avoid: people or hands, other objects, watermark, garbled or misspelt writing, placeholder lines or grey bars in place of writing, a badge removed or invented.
